description: Shared Vite 8, Vitest, Capacitor, tsup, TypeScript and Biome configuration for browser games, with headed, muted real-browser testing.
rules: defineBrowserTest is deprecated: use game-harness's defineBrowserTestConfig (game-harness/vitest) for browser tests.
defineBrowserTest is headed-only and always passes --mute-audio; never add a headless option.
Every factory accepts an overrides option that is merged last.
srcDir must be an absolute path; a relative path throws.
Use Rolldown codeSplitting groups through heavyDeps, never manualChunks.
Import from the subpaths (build-preset/vite, /vitest, /capacitor, /tsup); /tsup is not in the barrel.
The package has no runtime dependencies; vite, vitest, @vitest/browser-playwright and playwright are peers.
